title.zh-CN: 剖宫产后高热、腹痛伴腰腹部瘀斑 · 29岁女性
title.en: Fever, abdominal pain and flank bruising after a caesarean birth · 29-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 急诊剖宫产后第2天，一名29岁女性因持续高热、右侧腰痛加重和腰腹部大片瘀斑由外院转来。
summary.en: Two days after an emergency caesarean, a 29-year-old woman is transferred in with a high fever, worsening right-sided flank pain and extensive bruising over her abdomen and flank.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 根据迅速加重的疼痛、腰腹部和大腿的大片瘀斑、腹部体征和全身中毒表现，并结合两种抗菌方案无效，在CT或手术证实之前识别剖宫产后第2天的坏死性软组织感染（IDSA 2014；WSES/SIS-E 2018）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise a necrotising soft-tissue infection two days after a caesarean birth from rapidly worsening pain, extensive bruising of the abdomen, flank and thigh, abdominal signs and systemic toxicity despite two antibiotic regimens — before CT or operative confirmation (IDSA 2014; WSES/SIS-E 2018).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把白细胞1.39×10⁹/L、乳酸5.52 mmol/L、肌酐205 μmol/L、PT 19.2 s和血小板108×10⁹/L解读为脓毒症伴器官功能障碍，并说明为什么白细胞减少、qSOFA 1分和不完整的LRINEC评分都不能让人放心（Sepsis-3 2016；LRINEC，Wong 2004）。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret a white count of 1.39×10⁹/L, lactate 5.52 mmol/L, creatinine 205 μmol/L, PT 19.2 s and platelets 108×10⁹/L as sepsis with organ dysfunction, and explain why leucopenia, a qSOFA of 1 and an incomplete LRINEC score must not reassure (Sepsis-3 2016; LRINEC, Wong 2004).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 完成孕产妇脓毒症第一个小时的处理：不因留血培养推迟抗菌药物，按IDSA 2014给予经验性广谱方案并按肾功能调整，用平衡晶体液复苏并反复评估、不用淀粉类液体（拯救脓毒症运动2026；SMFM 2023），监护并收入ICU。
learningOutcomes.en: Deliver first-hour care for maternal sepsis: blood cultures without delaying antibiotics, an IDSA 2014 broad empirical regimen adjusted to renal function, balanced crystalloid with reassessment and no starch (SSC 2026; SMFM 2023), monitoring and intensive care.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 一旦怀疑就立即请外科急诊探查——不先换药观察、不先做CT、不先纠正凝血、不做床旁切开——力争数小时内清创（EAST 2018：疑诊后12小时内；拯救脓毒症运动2026：感染源控制最好在6小时内）。
learningOutcomes.en: Call for emergency surgical exploration as soon as the infection is suspected — not after antibiotic changes, CT, correction of clotting or a bedside incision — aiming for debridement within hours (EAST 2018: within 12 hours of suspicion; SSC 2026: source control ideally within 6 hours).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 发生感染性休克时把复苏带进手术室（去甲肾上腺素维持平均动脉压65 mmHg，持续需要升压药时加糖皮质激素——拯救脓毒症运动2026），计划多次清创，并把抗菌药物用到不再需要清创且退热48～72小时（IDSA 2014）。
learningOutcomes.en: Keep resuscitating into theatre when septic shock develops (noradrenaline to a mean arterial pressure of 65 mmHg; corticosteroids if vasopressors are still needed — SSC 2026), plan repeated debridement, and continue antibiotics until no further debridement is needed and she has been afebrile for 48–72 hours (IDSA 2014).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge方法，在她还能作决定时向这位受惊的新妈妈说明病情和紧急手术并征得同意，之后向家属说明；并在不受结局偏倚影响的前提下复盘有记录的延误。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain the illness and the urgent operation to a frightened new mother while she can still consent, and later to her family, using the Calgary–Cambridge approach, and review the documented delay without outcome bias.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表的单例报告改写。本版本（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容，按阶段重新组织并改写为患者和家属的口语，没有增加或改动任何数值、时间、药物或结局；尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、日历日期和身份细节已去除，时间以相对时间表示。1.0.0版自身的不一致和疑点（中文“侧切和胎头吸引失败”与英文“attempted episiotomy/vacuum”；英文反馈提到的“后来的抗凝治疗”在中文和其他字段中都没有；不可信的血钙62 mmol/L；“部分单位可疑”；“历史抢救药物组合”和“孕期糖尿病状态不详”没有具体内容；“约第5天”的起算点；“数小时内”的起点）全部保留或列入待核实。家属、对话、决策、干预、评分和教学要点为教学设计；CT和培养结果的阶段安排是教学呈现。5张经媒体审核批准的原图只随结局记录显示。
notes.en: Adapted from a published single-case report. In this version (1.1.0) every patient fact is the one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0, reorganised by stage and reworded into the patient's and the relative's lay speech; no value, timing, drug or outcome has been added or changed, and the facts have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed, and times are relative. Version 1.0.0's own inconsistencies and loose ends (the Chinese 'episiotomy and failed vacuum extraction' against the English 'attempted episiotomy/vacuum'; the 'later anticoagulation' that only the English feedback mentions; the implausible calcium of 62 mmol/L; 'some source units are questionable'; the unspecified 'historical resuscitation combinations' and 'gestational diabetes status unknown'; what 'around day 5' counts from; what 'within hours' counts from) are kept or listed to verify. The relative, the dialogue, decisions, interventions, scoring and teaching points are educational design; the staging of the CT and culture results is a teaching presentation. The five figures approved in the media review open only with the outcome record.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 剖腹产以后一直发高烧，右边腰越来越疼，肚子和腰上青紫了一大片
chiefComplaint.en: Since the caesarean I've had a high fever, my right side hurts more and more, and there's a big purple bruise over my tummy and side

triageNote.zh-CN: 29岁女性，急诊剖宫产后第2天由外院转入。术后2小时起发热，右侧腰痛进行性加重，次日起腰腹部大片瘀斑；外院先后用头孢唑林及甲硝唑、头孢曲松等，病情无好转。到达时神志尚清，被动体位，体温39.6 ℃，心率170次/分，呼吸44次/分，血压108/70 mmHg。
triageNote.en: 29-year-old woman transferred from another hospital on day 2 after an emergency caesarean section. Fever since 2 hours after the operation, right flank pain getting steadily worse and extensive bruising of the abdomen and flank since the next day; no improvement on cefazolin, then metronidazole, ceftriaxone and others. On arrival she is conscious and lying in a passive position: T 39.6 °C, HR 170/min, RR 44/min, BP 108/70 mmHg.

tags.en: Bruising over the abdomen and flank

personality.zh-CN: 29岁，两天前刚做了急诊剖宫产。高烧、肚子和右边腰疼、喘不上气，人很虚，躺着没法自己翻身；很害怕，但还能断断续续地回答问题。
personality.en: 29, two days after an emergency caesarean. Feverish, in pain in her tummy and right side and short of breath, she is weak and cannot shift herself in bed; she is frightened but can still answer in short bursts.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 短句，喘着气说，一次只说几个字；日常口语，不用医学术语；数字只说护士告诉过她的。
speechStyle.en: Short, breathless phrases, a few words at a time; everyday words, no medical terms; numbers only as the nurses told her.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生……我烧得厉害……右边腰好疼……喘不上气……
openingLine.en: Doctor… I'm burning up… my right side hurts so much… I can't catch my breath…

concerns.zh-CN: 我这是怎么了？是不是还要再开一刀？
concerns.en: What's happening to me? Will I need another operation?
Am I going to be all right?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 到达时清醒，但高热、气促、疼痛，躺着不能自己翻身；用短句、喘着气说话，不用术语。只回答问到的内容，不增减数字和时间；不知道的就说说不上来，绝不编造（包括孩子的情况、刀口的样子和小便多少）。病情恶化、意识丧失并气管插管以后，她不能说话，由床旁的家属回答。
actingNotes.en: On arrival she is conscious but feverish, breathless and in pain, and cannot shift herself in bed; she speaks in short, breathless phrases without medical terms. Answer only what is asked, never adding or changing numbers or times; for anything she does not know, say she is not sure — never invent (the baby, the wound, how much urine she passes). Once she has deteriorated, lost consciousness and been intubated she cannot speak, and the relative at the bedside answers.

persona.zh-CN: 她的家属，具体关系没有记录，一直陪在她身边。焦急、疲惫，说话直白，用日常的话；只知道医生告诉家里的情况，数值和用药让医生看病历，不知道的就说不知道，绝不替她猜。最想知道她能不能挺过来、还要做几次手术。
persona.en: A family member — the exact relationship is not recorded — who has stayed with her. Anxious and tired, speaks plainly in everyday words; knows only what the doctors have told the family, points the doctor to the notes for figures and drugs, says so when they do not know and never guesses for her. Above all wants to know whether she will pull through and how many operations she will need.

nonVerbalReason.zh-CN: 意识丧失后已气管插管

description.zh-CN: 她刚由外院转来，距急诊剖宫产2天。
description.en: She has just been transferred from another hospital, two days after an emergency caesarean section.

text.zh-CN: 急诊剖宫产（胎儿窘迫，行会阴侧切和胎头吸引失败后中转剖宫产）。术后2小时起发热，体温最高39.5 ℃；右侧腰痛进行性加重，术后次日起腰腹部出现大片瘀斑，疼痛和皮肤改变进展很快。术后用头孢唑林，后改用甲硝唑、头孢曲松等，病情无好转。因高热、瘀斑和全身情况加重转院。孕期未行正规产前检查；既往体健。
text.en: Emergency caesarean section (fetal distress; converted after an episiotomy and a failed vacuum extraction). Fever from 2 hours after the operation, maximum 39.5 °C; right flank pain getting steadily worse, and extensive bruising of the abdomen and flank from the day after the operation, the pain and the skin changes progressing rapidly. Cefazolin after the operation, then metronidazole, ceftriaxone and others, without improvement. Transferred because the fever, the bruising and her general condition were worsening. No regular antenatal care; previously healthy.

note.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录抗菌药物的剂量、给药途径和起止时间，也没有记录头孢唑林是预防用药还是治疗用药。
note.en: This case does not record the antibiotic doses, routes or timing, or whether the cefazolin was prophylaxis or treatment.

source.en: Report (version 1.0.0 extract): histology (acute necrotising fasciitis); its timing is not recorded, and the case shows it at the exploration stage

name.zh-CN: 原报告的后续经过与结局

text.zh-CN: 清创后仍发生广泛的皮肤和肌肉坏死，经多次清创、植皮和皮瓣修复，共住院403天，治愈出院。作者认为，发病约5天后才确诊并清创，时机偏晚。
text.en: After the debridement, extensive necrosis of skin and muscle still developed. She needed repeated debridement, skin grafting and flap reconstruction, spent 403 days in hospital and was discharged healed. The authors judged that the diagnosis and debridement, about 5 days after the illness began, came late.

note.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录各次手术的日期和次数、ICU病程、出院时的功能和随访情况。
note.en: This case does not record the dates and number of the operations, the intensive care course, her function at discharge or any follow-up.

source.zh-CN: 报告（1.0.0版摘录）：治疗与结局（清创后广泛皮肤和肌肉坏死；多次清创、植皮和皮瓣重建；住院403天，治愈出院；作者认为约第5天确诊并清创偏晚）
source.en: Report (version 1.0.0 extract): treatment and outcome (extensive skin and muscle necrosis after debridement; repeated debridement, grafting and flap reconstruction; 403 days in hospital, discharged healed; the authors judged diagnosis and debridement around day 5 late)

name.zh-CN: 建立静脉通路并留取血标本

dose.zh-CN: 两条大口径外周静脉留置针，同时留取血标本。
dose.en: Two large-bore peripheral cannulas, drawing the blood samples at the same time.

response.zh-CN: 两条静脉通路已建立，血标本已留取。本病例没有记录她的静脉通路情况。
response.en: Two cannulas are in and the bloods are taken. The case does not record her lines.

name.zh-CN: 心电、血压和血氧饱和度持续监护
name.en: Continuous ECG, blood pressure and oxygen saturation monitoring

response.zh-CN: 监护已接上。除到达时的生命体征外，本病例没有记录监护数值。
response.en: She is on the monitor. Apart from the arrival observations, the case records no monitored values.

dose.zh-CN: 面罩吸氧，按血氧饱和度调节（本病例没有记录她的血氧饱和度）。
dose.en: Oxygen by face mask, titrated to her saturation (her SpO₂ is not recorded).

response.zh-CN: 已经给她吸上氧。本病例没有记录她的血氧饱和度，不模拟其效果。
response.en: The oxygen is on. The case records no oxygen saturation and does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 留置导尿，记录每小时尿量
name.en: Urinary catheter with hourly urine output

response.zh-CN: 已留置导尿管。本病例没有记录她的尿量。
response.en: The catheter is in. The case does not record her urine output.

dose.zh-CN: 平衡晶体液（如乳酸林格液）每次约500 mL快速输注，每次后复评；最初3小时内总量可达30 mL/kg（按实测或估计体重，本病例没有记录体重）。
dose.en: Balanced crystalloid (e.g. Hartmann's or lactated Ringer's) in boluses of about 500 mL, reassessing after each, up to 30 mL/kg in the first 3 hours (by measured or estimated weight — her weight is not recorded).

response.zh-CN: 补液已开始。本病例没有记录补液量，不模拟其效果。
response.en: The fluid is running. The case records no fluid volumes and does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 静脉广谱抗菌药物（哌拉西林他唑巴坦或碳青霉烯类，加万古霉素）
name.en: IV broad-spectrum antibiotics (piperacillin–tazobactam or a carbapenem, plus vancomycin)

dose.zh-CN: 先问清药物过敏史（本病例没有记录）。哌拉西林他唑巴坦4.5 g静脉滴注，每6～8小时一次（或美罗培南1 g，每8小时一次），按肾功能调整；加万古霉素，按体重给负荷量，再按血药浓度和肾功能调整；怀疑链球菌感染时可加克林霉素。
dose.en: Ask about drug allergies first (not recorded in this case). Piperacillin–tazobactam 4.5 g IV every 6–8 hours (or meropenem 1 g every 8 hours), adjusted to renal function; plus vancomycin, a weight-based loading dose then dosing by levels and renal function; consider clindamycin while streptococcal infection is possible.

response.zh-CN: 首剂已静脉给入。本病例没有记录她转院后的抗菌方案，不模拟其效果。
response.en: The first doses are in. The case does not record her antibiotics after the transfer and does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 急诊外科探查（立即请外科会诊并安排手术）
name.en: Emergency surgical exploration (call the surgical team and book theatre now)

dose.zh-CN: 立即电话通知外科（联合产科），取得知情同意、交叉配血并通知麻醉科；在手术室探查，按所见处理。
dose.en: Phone the surgical team now (with the obstetric team), take consent, cross-match blood and alert the anaesthetist; explore in theatre and treat what is found.

response.zh-CN: 外科同意立即手术探查，正在准备手术室。
response.en: The surgical team accepts her for emergency exploration, and theatre is being prepared.

dose.zh-CN: 联系重症医学科，转入ICU床位。
dose.en: Call the intensive care team and move her to an ICU bed.

response.zh-CN: 她被转入ICU床位。本病例没有记录她在手术前于何处接受治疗。
response.en: She is moved to an ICU bed. The case does not record where she was cared for before the operation.

name.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素持续静脉泵入

dose.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素持续泵入，滴定至平均动脉压65 mmHg。
dose.en: Noradrenaline infusion titrated to a mean arterial pressure of 65 mmHg.

response.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素已开始泵入。本病例没有记录升压药的种类和剂量，不模拟其效果。
response.en: The noradrenaline is running. The case does not record which vasopressors were used or their doses, and does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 持续需要升压药维持时，氢化可的松50 mg静脉注射，每6小时一次（200 mg/d）。
dose.en: When the vasopressor need persists: hydrocortisone 50 mg IV every 6 hours (200 mg a day).

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录是否使用糖皮质激素，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. The case does not record whether corticosteroids were used and does not simulate the effect.

response.zh-CN: 她已气管插管并接上呼吸机。本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: She is intubated and ventilated. The case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 计划性再次手术探查（二次探查）

dose.zh-CN: 首次清创后24～48小时内返回手术室复查，有坏死就再清创，直到不再有坏死组织。
dose.en: Back to theatre within 24–48 hours of the first debridement, debriding again wherever necrosis remains, until none is left.

response.zh-CN: 已预约计划性再次手术探查。
response.en: A planned second-look operation is booked.

name.zh-CN: 告知孩子的主管医生母亲的感染情况
name.en: Tell the baby's doctors about her infection

dose.zh-CN: 电话告知负责孩子的新生儿科或儿科医生：母亲产后2天内出现严重感染。
dose.en: Phone the neonatal or paediatric team caring for the baby: the mother developed a severe infection within 2 days of the birth.

response.zh-CN: 已经通知。本病例没有记录孩子的情况，也没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Done. The case does not record the baby's condition or whether this was done, and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 更换抗菌药物，观察24小时后再评估
name.en: Change the antibiotics and reassess in 24 hours

harm.zh-CN: 两种方案都已失败，疼痛和皮肤改变仍在迅速进展，再换药观察只会重复无效的做法：抗菌药物到不了坏死组织，只有手术能清除。IDSA 2014建议对伴全身中毒表现或疑似坏死性感染的患者立即请外科会诊；EAST 2018建议疑诊后12小时内首次清创——其荟萃分析中早清创组病死率14%，晚清创组25.8%。
harm.en: Two regimens have already failed while the pain and skin changes progress rapidly; changing drugs and waiting repeats what has not worked — antibiotics do not reach dead tissue, and only an operation removes it. IDSA 2014 recommends prompt surgical consultation for an aggressive infection with systemic toxicity or a suspected necrotising infection; EAST 2018 recommends the first debridement within 12 hours of suspicion (mortality 14% early versus 25.8% late in its meta-analysis).

response.zh-CN: 你更换了抗菌药物，计划观察后再评估。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: You change the antibiotics and plan to reassess. The case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 先做CT，根据结果再决定是否请外科
name.en: Get CT first and decide on a surgical referral from the result

harm.zh-CN: 影像只能辅助诊断，不能推迟外科评估：皮下积气支持诊断，但没有积气也不能排除。她有迅速进展的皮肤改变和全身中毒表现，应先请外科（IDSA 2014）；CT不得推迟手术，拯救脓毒症运动2026建议需要感染源控制时尽早完成，最好在诊断后6小时内。
harm.en: Imaging can support the diagnosis but must not delay surgical assessment: gas supports it, but its absence does not exclude it. With rapidly progressing skin changes and systemic toxicity she needs the surgeons first (IDSA 2014); a CT must not hold up theatre, and SSC 2026 suggests source control early, ideally within 6 hours of diagnosis.

response.zh-CN: CT已预约。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；CT报告在下一阶段显示（做CT的时间没有记录）。
response.en: The CT is booked. The case does not simulate what would follow; the CT report is shown in the next stage (when it was done is not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 先输血浆和血小板纠正凝血，再决定是否手术
name.en: Correct the clotting with plasma and platelets before deciding on surgery

harm.zh-CN: 她的凝血异常（PT 19.2 s、血小板108×10⁹/L）更可能是脓毒症的一部分，感染源不清除就难以纠正；手术中可以按出血和检验结果输注血制品，但不能为此推迟感染源控制（拯救脓毒症运动2026；EAST 2018）。
harm.en: Her clotting abnormality (PT 19.2 s, platelets 108×10⁹/L) is more likely part of the sepsis and will be hard to correct while the source remains; blood products can be given in theatre as bleeding and results require, but they must not delay source control (SSC 2026; EAST 2018).

response.zh-CN: 血制品已申请。本病例没有记录输血，不模拟其效果；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: The blood products are ordered. The case records no transfusion and does not simulate the effect; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.en: Open and drain the wound at the bedside

harm.zh-CN: 床旁切开既看不清筋膜层，也清除不了坏死组织，还会让人误以为已经处理了感染源；探查和清创要在手术室、在麻醉下完成（IDSA 2014；WSES/SIS-E 2018）。
harm.en: A bedside incision can neither show the fascia nor remove dead tissue, and it gives a false sense that the source has been dealt with; exploration and debridement belong in theatre under anaesthesia (IDSA 2014; WSES/SIS-E 2018).

response.zh-CN: 已在床旁拆开部分刀口。本病例没有记录这一步，不模拟其结果。
response.en: Part of the wound is opened at the bedside. The case does not record this and does not simulate the result.

harm.zh-CN: 她的白蛋白只有11.2 g/L，看起来像需要胶体，但SMFM 2023（第67号咨询）反对在孕产妇脓毒症复苏中使用淀粉或明胶类液体；淀粉类液体还可能进一步损害她已经受损的肾功能（肌酐205 μmol/L）。用平衡晶体液。
harm.en: An albumin of 11.2 g/L makes a colloid look tempting, but SMFM Consult #67 (2023) recommends against starches or gelatin for resuscitation in maternal sepsis, and starch may further harm kidney function that is already impaired (creatinine 205 μmol/L). Use a balanced crystalloid.

response.zh-CN: 已开始输注。本病例没有记录这种液体，不模拟其效果。
response.en: It is running. The case does not record this fluid and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 先在ICU稳定，停用升压药后再手术
name.en: Stabilise in intensive care and operate once off vasopressors

harm.zh-CN: 感染源本身就是她休克的原因，不清除它，休克难以纠正；复苏应在手术室里继续，而不是等稳定以后再手术（拯救脓毒症运动2026：感染源控制最好在诊断后6小时内；EAST 2018：疑诊后12小时内清创）。
harm.en: The source is what keeps her in shock; without removing it the shock is unlikely to settle. Resuscitation continues in theatre — it is not a reason to wait (SSC 2026: source control ideally within 6 hours of diagnosis; EAST 2018: debridement within 12 hours of suspicion).

response.zh-CN: 手术暂缓。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Surgery is put off. The case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

title.en: Take the story of this illness

hint.zh-CN: 发热、疼痛和皮肤改变各从什么时候开始，变化有多快？分娩是怎么进行的？在外院已经用过哪些药，效果如何？
hint.en: When did the fever, the pain and the skin changes begin, and how fast have they changed? How did the birth go? Which drugs has she already had, and did they help?

guidance.zh-CN: 她刚到，还清醒，能断断续续地自己回答。
guidance.en: She has just arrived; she is conscious and answers for herself in short bursts.

title.zh-CN: 查体并看到达时的化验
title.en: Examine her and read the arrival bloods

hint.zh-CN: 她的生命体征说明了什么？腹部和皮肤的表现能用普通的切口感染解释吗？化验里哪些数字最让你担心——白细胞低是好消息吗？
hint.en: What do her vital signs tell you? Do the abdomen and the skin fit an ordinary wound infection? Which numbers worry you most — and is a low white count good news?

guidance.zh-CN: 床旁查体；血标本在床旁留取，结果在病历终端或床旁查看。
guidance.en: Examine her at the bedside; bloods are taken there, and results are read at a records terminal or at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 第一个小时：作出判断并采取行动
title.en: The first hour: decide and act

hint.zh-CN: 什么病能同时解释这些皮肤、腹部和全身表现？抗菌药物已经换过两次——还缺了什么？哪些检查和处理可以等，哪些一刻也不能等？
hint.en: Which condition explains the skin, the abdomen and the systemic picture together? The antibiotics have been changed twice — what is missing? What can wait, and what cannot?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上作答决策 1 和决策 2，然后按你的计划下医嘱。
guidance.en: Answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board, then act on your plan.

title.zh-CN: 她病情恶化时重新评估

hint.zh-CN: 她的皮肤和下肢有什么新变化？家属看到了什么？休克时还能不能上手术台——什么才能让休克好转？
hint.en: What has changed in her skin and her legs, and what did her relative see? Is she too unwell for theatre — or what would it take for the shock to improve?

guidance.zh-CN: 她已意识丧失并气管插管，一位家属在床旁。
guidance.en: She has lost consciousness and is intubated; a relative is at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 看术中所见并安排之后几天
title.en: Read the findings and plan the next days

hint.zh-CN: 手术所见和培养结果改变了什么？一次手术够不够？抗菌药物用到什么时候、根据什么调整？
hint.en: What do the operative findings and the cultures change? Is one operation enough? How long do the antibiotics run, and what guides any change?

guidance.zh-CN: 她在手术室接受首次探查。
guidance.en: She is in theatre for the first exploration.

title.zh-CN: 查看她此后的经过与结局
title.en: Read what happened to her afterwards

hint.zh-CN: 她最终痊愈出院——这能说明当时处理的时机没有问题吗？
hint.en: She left hospital healed in the end — does that show the timing was safe?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端查看原报告记录的后续经过与结局。
guidance.en: Read the reported course and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 急诊剖宫产（胎儿窘迫，侧切和胎头吸引失败后中转）后第2天：术后2小时起发热，最高39.5 ℃；腹痛，右侧腰痛越来越重；腰腹部和左大腿上部大片紫红色瘀斑；先后用头孢唑林及甲硝唑、头孢曲松无效。体温39.6 ℃，心率170次/分，呼吸44次/分，血压108/70 mmHg；腹部压痛、反跳痛，右侧明显。白细胞1.39×10⁹/L，血红蛋白94 g/L，血小板108×10⁹/L，肌酐205 μmol/L，乳酸5.52 mmol/L，PT 19.2 s。哪个工作诊断应当主导接下来这一小时？
prompt.en: Day 2 after an emergency caesarean (fetal distress; converted after an episiotomy and a failed vacuum extraction): fever since 2 hours after the operation, maximum 39.5 °C; abdominal pain, and right flank pain getting worse; extensive purple-red bruising of the abdomen, flank and upper left thigh; no response to cefazolin, then metronidazole and ceftriaxone. T 39.6 °C, HR 170/min, RR 44/min, BP 108/70 mmHg; tender abdomen with rebound, worse on the right. WBC 1.39×10⁹/L, Hb 94 g/L, platelets 108×10⁹/L, creatinine 205 μmol/L, lactate 5.52 mmol/L, PT 19.2 s. Which working diagnosis should drive the next hour?

need.zh-CN: 先问清这次发病的经过、分娩和用药情况，测生命体征、检查腹部和皮肤，并看过到达时的血常规、生化、乳酸和凝血结果。
need.en: Take the story of this illness, the birth and the antibiotics so far; take her vital signs and examine her abdomen and skin; and read the arrival blood count, biochemistry, lactate and clotting.

text.zh-CN: 腹壁和腰部的坏死性软组织感染，伴脓毒症和器官功能障碍，要靠手术探查确诊
text.en: A necrotising soft-tissue infection of the abdominal wall and flank with sepsis and organ dysfunction, confirmed only at exploration

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。术后数小时起高热，疼痛和皮肤改变迅速进展，腰腹部和左大腿上部大片瘀斑，伴心率170次/分、呼吸44次/分、乳酸5.52 mmol/L、肌酐205 μmol/L和PT延长，而两种抗菌方案都无效——这是深部坏死性感染的表现，不是普通的切口感染。IDSA 2014建议一旦怀疑坏死性感染就立即请外科会诊；诊断要在探查中确立，不能等CT或培养。
feedback.en: Right. Fever from hours after the operation, pain and skin changes progressing fast, extensive bruising of the abdomen, flank and upper left thigh, HR 170/min, RR 44/min, lactate 5.52 mmol/L, creatinine 205 μmol/L and a prolonged PT, with two failed antibiotic regimens: this is a deep necrotising infection, not a wound infection. IDSA 2014 recommends prompt surgical consultation as soon as a necrotising infection is suspected; the diagnosis is made at exploration, not by waiting for CT or cultures.

text.zh-CN: 凝血异常引起的切口或腰部血肿，发热是血肿吸收热，先纠正凝血再观察
text.en: A wound or flank haematoma caused by the clotting abnormality, with fever as a reaction to the blood: correct the clotting first and observe

feedback.zh-CN: 血肿值得排除，但解释不了全貌：血红蛋白94 g/L只是中度贫血，她却有心率170次/分、高热、白细胞减少和乳酸5.52 mmol/L。凝血异常更可能是脓毒症的一部分，先纠正再观察会耽误手术；无论哪种解释，都需要外科立即评估（IDSA 2014）。
feedback.en: A haematoma is worth excluding, but it does not explain the picture: a haemoglobin of 94 g/L is only moderate anaemia, yet she has HR 170/min, a high fever, leucopenia and lactate 5.52 mmol/L. The clotting abnormality is more likely part of sepsis, and correcting it before acting delays surgery; either way she needs the surgeons now (IDSA 2014).

text.zh-CN: 剖宫产后子宫内膜炎合并切口蜂窝织炎，换用更广谱的抗菌药物，24小时后复评腹部和皮肤
text.en: Post-caesarean endometritis with wound cellulitis: broaden the antibiotics and review the abdomen and skin in 24 hours

feedback.zh-CN: 这接近原报告中先后换用抗菌药物的做法。蜂窝织炎不会在两天内造成迅速进展的瘀斑、肾损害和凝血异常；两种方案都已失败，提示存在抗菌药物到不了的坏死组织，需要外科探查，而不是再观察24小时（IDSA 2014）。
feedback.en: This is close to the report's sequence of antibiotic changes. Cellulitis does not produce rapidly progressing bruising, kidney injury and a clotting abnormality within two days; two failed regimens point to dead tissue the drugs cannot reach, which needs surgical exploration, not another 24 hours of observation (IDSA 2014).

text.zh-CN: 白细胞只有1.39×10⁹/L，不支持严重细菌感染，更像病毒感染或药物反应
text.en: A viral illness or a drug reaction, because a white count of 1.39×10⁹/L argues against severe bacterial infection

feedback.zh-CN: 白细胞减少不是排除细菌感染的理由，而是重症的信号：白细胞<4×10⁹/L本身就是SIRS标准之一，与乳酸5.52 mmol/L、肌酐205 μmol/L一起提示脓毒症伴器官功能障碍（Sepsis-3，2016）。因为“白细胞不高”而放心，是这类感染延误诊断的常见原因。
feedback.en: Leucopenia is no reason to exclude bacterial infection — it is a sign of severity: a white count below 4×10⁹/L is itself a SIRS criterion and, with lactate 5.52 mmol/L and creatinine 205 μmol/L, marks sepsis with organ dysfunction (Sepsis-3, 2016). Being reassured by a white count that is not raised is a common cause of delay in these infections.

prompt.zh-CN: 你考虑坏死性软组织感染伴脓毒症。她神志尚清，血压108/70 mmHg，乳酸5.52 mmol/L，肌酐205 μmol/L，体重没有记录。第一个小时你怎么处理？
prompt.en: You suspect a necrotising soft-tissue infection with sepsis. She is conscious, BP 108/70 mmHg, lactate 5.52 mmol/L, creatinine 205 μmol/L; her weight is not recorded. What do you do in the first hour?

need.zh-CN: 先在决策 1 中确定工作诊断。
need.en: Settle the working diagnosis in decision 1 first.

text.zh-CN: 留血培养后1小时内静脉给哌拉西林他唑巴坦或碳青霉烯类加万古霉素（按肾功能调整），平衡晶体液复苏，并立即请外科急诊探查
text.en: Take blood cultures, give IV piperacillin–tazobactam or a carbapenem plus vancomycin within the hour (renal doses), start balanced crystalloid, and call the surgeons now to explore

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。拯救脓毒症运动2026：可行时先留血培养，可能的感染性休克或很可能的脓毒症在1小时内给抗菌药物；乳酸5.52 mmol/L提示灌注不足，建议平衡晶体液（最初可达30 mL/kg）并反复评估；需要感染源控制时最好在诊断后6小时内完成。IDSA 2014的经验方案为万古霉素或利奈唑胺加哌拉西林他唑巴坦或碳青霉烯类，并建议立即请外科会诊，EAST 2018建议疑诊后12小时内首次清创；她的过敏史没有记录，首剂前要问清并查看转诊资料。
feedback.en: Right. SSC 2026: blood cultures first when feasible, antimicrobials within 1 hour for possible septic shock or probable sepsis; lactate 5.52 mmol/L signals hypoperfusion, so balanced crystalloid (up to 30 mL/kg at first) with repeated reassessment; source control ideally within 6 hours of diagnosis. IDSA 2014's empirical regimen is vancomycin or linezolid plus piperacillin–tazobactam or a carbapenem, with prompt surgical consultation, and EAST 2018 recommends the first debridement within 12 hours of suspicion; her allergy history is not recorded, so ask and check the notes before the first dose.

text.zh-CN: 留血培养后，1小时内改用美罗培南加万古霉素（按肾功能调整），平衡晶体液补液并复评，先观察24小时，病情不好转再请外科会诊
text.en: Take blood cultures, switch to meropenem plus vancomycin within the hour (renal doses), start balanced crystalloid with reassessment, and observe for 24 hours before calling the surgeons

feedback.zh-CN: 这类似她转院前的经过：抗菌药物一换再换，感染源却留在原处。美罗培南加万古霉素本身可以接受，但观察24小时违背了IDSA 2014立即请外科会诊的建议；EAST 2018的荟萃分析中，首次清创晚于12小时者病死率25.8%，早清创者14%。
feedback.en: This resembles her course before the transfer: antibiotics changed again and again while the source stayed in place. Meropenem plus vancomycin is a reasonable regimen, but a 24-hour wait goes against IDSA 2014's prompt surgical consultation; in EAST 2018's meta-analysis, mortality was 25.8% when the first debridement came after 12 hours, against 14% when it came earlier.

text.zh-CN: 留血培养后，1小时内给同样的广谱抗菌药物和平衡晶体液，先做腹部、盆腔及大腿CT，看到积气或积液再请外科会诊
text.en: Take blood cultures, give the same broad antibiotics and balanced crystalloid within the hour, and get CT of the abdomen, pelvis and thighs first, calling the surgeons if it shows gas

feedback.zh-CN: CT可以帮助了解范围，但不能决定外科来不来：没有积气不能排除坏死性感染，预约和转运还会推迟手术。她有迅速进展的皮肤改变和全身中毒表现，应先请外科（IDSA 2014）；拯救脓毒症运动2026建议感染源控制最好在诊断后6小时内完成。
feedback.en: CT can help map the extent, but it must not decide whether the surgeons come: no gas does not exclude a necrotising infection, and booking and transfer delay theatre. With rapidly progressing skin changes and systemic toxicity, call the surgeons first (IDSA 2014); SSC 2026 suggests source control ideally within 6 hours of diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 留血培养后，1小时内给同样的广谱抗菌药物和平衡晶体液，先输新鲜冰冻血浆和血小板，把PT和血小板纠正到正常，再决定是否手术
text.en: Take blood cultures, give the same broad antibiotics and balanced crystalloid within the hour, and bring the PT and platelets to normal with plasma and platelets before deciding on surgery

feedback.zh-CN: PT 19.2 s和血小板108×10⁹/L更可能是脓毒症的一部分，感染源不清除很难纠正；把凝血“纠正到正常”作为手术前提，会耽误感染源控制。血制品可以在手术中按出血和检验结果使用（拯救脓毒症运动2026；EAST 2018）。
feedback.en: A PT of 19.2 s and platelets of 108×10⁹/L are more likely part of the sepsis and will be hard to correct while the source remains; making a normal clotting screen a precondition delays source control. Blood products can be given in theatre as bleeding and results require (SSC 2026; EAST 2018).

prompt.zh-CN: 到达数小时后，她的皮肤出现水疱，下肢花斑，发生感染性休克，意识丧失后已气管插管。接下来怎么做？
prompt.en: A few hours after arrival, bullae have formed on her skin, her legs are mottled and she is in septic shock; she lost consciousness and has been intubated. What now?

need.zh-CN: 先重新评估她的意识和呼吸支持、生命体征、皮肤和下肢循环。
need.en: Reassess her conscious level and breathing support, her vital signs, her skin and the circulation in her legs first.

text.zh-CN: 立即送手术室探查并彻底清创，复苏同时进行：去甲肾上腺素维持平均动脉压65 mmHg，仍需升压药时加氢化可的松
text.en: Take her to theatre now for exploration and radical debridement, resuscitating as she goes: noradrenaline to a MAP of 65 mmHg, and hydrocortisone if vasopressors are still needed

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。感染源控制本身就是复苏的一部分：拯救脓毒症运动2026建议感染源控制最好在诊断后6小时内完成，以去甲肾上腺素为一线升压药、初始平均动脉压目标65 mmHg，持续需要升压药时建议静脉糖皮质激素（证据确定性低）。EAST 2018建议疑诊后12小时内首次清创；术中按出血情况和PT、血小板结果输注血制品。
feedback.en: Right. Source control is part of resuscitation: SSC 2026 suggests source control ideally within 6 hours of diagnosis, noradrenaline as the first-line vasopressor, an initial mean arterial pressure target of 65 mmHg and IV corticosteroids when vasopressors are still needed (low certainty). EAST 2018 recommends the first debridement within 12 hours of suspicion; blood products are given in theatre as bleeding, the PT and the platelets require.

text.zh-CN: 先在ICU稳定：继续广谱抗菌药物和补液，去甲肾上腺素维持平均动脉压65 mmHg，必要时加氢化可的松，停用升压药后再手术
text.en: Stabilise her in intensive care first — broad antibiotics, fluids, noradrenaline to a MAP of 65 mmHg and hydrocortisone if needed — and book the debridement once she is off vasopressors

feedback.zh-CN: “太不稳定，不能手术”是这里最危险的推理：休克正是由感染源造成的，不清除它，停用升压药的那一天可能不会到来。复苏和手术应同时进行（拯救脓毒症运动2026；EAST 2018）。
feedback.en: 'Too unstable for theatre' is the most dangerous reasoning here: the source is what keeps her in shock, and the day she comes off vasopressors may never arrive while it remains. Resuscitation and surgery go together (SSC 2026; EAST 2018).

text.zh-CN: 先转去做高压氧治疗阻止感染扩散，等坏死范围分界清楚后再清创，其间继续去甲肾上腺素和广谱抗菌药物
text.en: Transfer her for hyperbaric oxygen first to halt the spread, and debride once the necrosis has demarcated, continuing noradrenaline and the broad antibiotics meanwhile

feedback.zh-CN: 高压氧的获益没有得到证实，转运和治疗还会耽误复苏和清创——这正是IDSA 2014不推荐在梭菌性肌坏死中使用高压氧的理由。等坏死“分界清楚”，只会让它继续扩大。
feedback.en: Hyperbaric oxygen has no proven benefit, and the transfer and sessions delay resuscitation and debridement — the reasons IDSA 2014 gives for not recommending it in clostridial myonecrosis. Waiting for the necrosis to 'demarcate' only lets it spread.

text.zh-CN: 静脉注射免疫球蛋白，继续去甲肾上腺素和广谱抗菌药物，等血培养和药敏结果出来再决定手术范围
text.en: Give intravenous immunoglobulin, continue noradrenaline and the broad antibiotics, and wait for the culture and susceptibility results before deciding how much to operate

feedback.zh-CN: 免疫球蛋白清除不了感染源，在坏死性感染中的获益也没有得到证实；等药敏结果会把清创推迟一天以上，而手术范围取决于术中所见，不取决于药敏（EAST 2018：疑诊后12小时内首次清创）。
feedback.en: Immunoglobulin does not remove the source and its benefit in necrotising infection is unproven; waiting for susceptibilities delays debridement by a day or more, and the extent of surgery is set by what is found in theatre, not by the culture (EAST 2018: first debridement within 12 hours of suspicion).

prompt.zh-CN: 探查见筋膜发黑、坏死，有恶臭渗液。血培养和水疱液培养均为大肠埃希菌，药敏结果没有记录。首次清创之后的计划是什么？
prompt.en: At exploration the fascia is black and necrotic with foul-smelling exudate. Blood and blister-fluid cultures grow Escherichia coli; no susceptibility result is recorded. What is the plan after this first debridement?

need.zh-CN: 先看手术记录，并查看这一阶段的血培养和水疱液培养结果。
need.en: Read the operation note and the blood and skin-fluid culture results at this stage first.

text.zh-CN: 24～48小时内计划性再次探查，有坏死就再清创；按药敏调整抗菌药物，用到不再需要清创、临床好转且退热48～72小时
text.en: Plan a second look within 24–48 hours and debride again wherever necrosis remains; adjust antibiotics to susceptibilities and continue until debridement stops and she is afebrile for 48–72 hours

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。坏死性感染首次清创后常需多次手术，应计划性返回手术室复查，而不是等病情恶化（IDSA 2014）；IDSA 2014建议抗菌药物用到不再需要清创、临床好转并退热48～72小时。本病例没有记录药敏，降阶梯要等结果。
feedback.en: Right. Necrotising infection usually needs more than one operation, so the return to theatre is planned rather than triggered by deterioration (IDSA 2014); IDSA 2014 continues antibiotics until no further debridement is needed, she has improved and has been afebrile for 48–72 hours. Narrowing waits for the susceptibilities, which this case does not record.

text.zh-CN: 一次彻底清创已经足够：敷料覆盖创面，病情好转后转回普通病房，只有病情恶化时才再回手术室，抗菌药物固定用满14天后停用
text.en: One radical debridement is enough: dress the wound, step her down to the ward once she improves, return to theatre only if she deteriorates, and simply stop the antibiotics after a fixed 14-day course

feedback.zh-CN: 一次清创很少足够；等到病情恶化再回手术室，坏死已在继续扩大。固定14天疗程也不符合IDSA 2014按清创和临床情况决定疗程的建议。
feedback.en: A single debridement is rarely enough, and waiting for deterioration lets necrosis keep spreading. A fixed 14-day course also ignores IDSA 2014's rule of treating until debridement has stopped and she is clinically better.

text.zh-CN: 大肠埃希菌通常对头孢曲松敏感，现在就改回头孢曲松单药，48小时后一期缝合创面，以减少液体丢失和再次感染
text.en: E. coli is usually susceptible to ceftriaxone, so narrow to ceftriaxone alone now and close the wound primarily at 48 hours to cut fluid loss and further infection

feedback.zh-CN: 她正是在包括头孢曲松在内的方案下病情加重的；降阶梯要依据药敏，而本病例没有记录药敏，不能凭“通常敏感”。IDSA 2014建议抗菌药物用到不再需要清创为止，在此之前创面也不应关闭。
feedback.en: She deteriorated on a regimen that included ceftriaxone; narrowing follows the organism's susceptibilities, which this case does not record, not what is 'usually' true. IDSA 2014 keeps treating until no further debridement is needed, and until then the wound is not closed.

text.zh-CN: 下次手术直接用皮瓣覆盖创面，不再清创，以缩短住院时间；体温正常24小时后停用抗菌药物
text.en: At the next operation cover the defect with a flap instead of debriding again, to shorten her stay, and stop the antibiotics once she has been afebrile for 24 hours

feedback.zh-CN: 在可能仍有残留坏死时做皮瓣，会把感染封在下面；重建要等到不再需要清创以后。体温正常24小时就停药，也短于IDSA 2014建议的退热48～72小时。
feedback.en: A flap over tissue that may still harbour necrosis seals the infection in; reconstruction waits until no further debridement is needed. Stopping antibiotics after 24 hours without fever is also shorter than the 48–72 afebrile hours IDSA 2014 advises.

text.zh-CN: 问清发热的起始和最高体温、腹痛和右侧腰痛加重的经过、瘀斑出现的时间和进展速度、分娩经过、外院用过的抗菌药物、药物过敏和孕期产检
text.en: Took the story of the fever and its peak, the abdominal pain and the worsening right flank pain, when the bruising appeared and how fast it progressed, the birth, the antibiotics already given, drug allergies and antenatal care

text.zh-CN: 查看神志和体位、测生命体征、触诊腹部，并检查腰腹部和大腿的皮肤
text.en: Assessed her conscious level and posture, took her vital signs, palpated the abdomen and examined the skin of the abdomen, flank and thigh

text.zh-CN: 看过到达时的血常规、生化、乳酸和凝血结果，并在到达阶段送检血培养
text.en: Read the arrival blood count, biochemistry, lactate and clotting, and sent blood cultures in the arrival stage

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把坏死性软组织感染伴脓毒症作为工作诊断（决策 1）
text.en: Made a necrotising soft-tissue infection with sepsis the working diagnosis at the first attempt (decision 1)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择在第一个小时内留培养、给广谱抗菌药物、补液并立即请外科（决策 2）
text.en: Chose cultures, broad antibiotics, fluids and an immediate surgical call for the first hour, at the first attempt (decision 2)

text.zh-CN: 到达后立即请外科急诊探查，之前没有先换药观察、先做CT、先纠正凝血或床旁拆开刀口
text.en: Called the surgical team for emergency exploration on arrival, without first observing on new antibiotics, waiting for CT, correcting the clotting or opening the wound at the bedside

text.zh-CN: 建立静脉通路，给予广谱抗菌药物和平衡晶体液，接上监护并留置导尿，收入ICU
text.en: Placed IV access, gave broad-spectrum antibiotics and balanced crystalloid, put her on the monitor with a urinary catheter, and admitted her to intensive care

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择在复苏的同时立即手术（决策 3），并开始去甲肾上腺素
text.en: Chose immediate surgery with resuscitation continuing, at the first attempt (decision 3), and started noradrenaline

text.zh-CN: 没有用羟乙基淀粉扩容，也没有在她休克时为了等待稳定而推迟手术
text.en: Gave no hydroxyethyl starch and did not put off surgery to wait for stability while she was in shock

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制定首次清创后的计划（决策 4），并预约计划性再次探查
text.en: Planned the days after the first debridement at the first attempt (decision 4) and booked the planned second look

text.zh-CN: 把母亲的严重感染告知孩子的主管医生
text.en: Told the baby's doctors about the mother's severe infection

text.zh-CN: 她清醒时用通俗的话说明病情和紧急手术并征得同意；插管后向家属说明情况和不确定性
text.en: Explained the illness and the urgent operation in plain words and sought her consent while she was conscious, then explained the situation and its uncertainty to her relative after she was intubated

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge评价两次谈话。到达时（她清醒、气促、害怕）：先自我介绍，用简短的句子；先问她知道多少；用通俗的话说明——刀口周围和肚子、腰部皮下的组织很可能有严重的感染，在往深处和周围蔓延，药物已经控制不住，需要马上手术把坏的组织清除，可能要做不止一次，术后要在重症监护室治疗；说明不做或推迟的风险；回应她“还要再开一刀吗”“我会不会有危险”的担心，不作虚假保证；在她还能作决定的时候征得同意，请她复述要点。她插管以后与家属谈：说明发生了什么（皮肤起疱、下肢花斑、休克、意识丧失、插管）、手术的必要性和不确定的预后，回答“还能不能挺过来”“要做几次手术”的问题时不说病例没有记录的数字；询问谁在照顾孩子、家里能得到哪些支持。不得说出原报告的结局（住院天数、植皮和皮瓣）。本病例没有记录这两次谈话。
judgeGuidance.en: Judge both conversations by Calgary–Cambridge. On arrival (conscious, breathless, frightened): introduce yourself and use short sentences; ask what she understands first; explain in plain words that the tissue under the skin around the wound, the abdomen and her side very probably has a severe infection spreading deeper and wider, that the drugs have not controlled it, that she needs an operation now to remove the damaged tissue — possibly more than one — and intensive care afterwards; say what refusing or delaying would risk; respond to her fears ('another operation?', 'am I going to be all right?') without false reassurance; seek her consent while she can still decide, and check understanding by teach-back. After she is intubated, speak with her relative: what has happened (blisters, mottled legs, shock, loss of consciousness, the breathing tube), why surgery cannot wait, and the uncertain outlook — answering 'will she pull through?' and 'how many operations?' without numbers the case does not record; ask who is caring for the baby and what support the family has. Do not reveal the reported outcome (length of stay, grafts and flaps). This case does not record either conversation.

name.zh-CN: 邵医生（产科主治医师，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“术后两小时就发热，第二天皮肤大片青紫，这像普通的切口感染吗？”“白细胞明显减低，你是更放心还是更担心？”“qSOFA只有1分，SIRS四项全中——你相信哪个？”“LRINEC你能算出几分，缺了哪几项？分数低能排除吗？”“抗菌药物已经换过两次，问题出在药上还是出在别处？”“哪些检查可以等，哪些处理不能等？”“休克了还能不能上手术台？”“一次清创够不够？”“她痊愈了，能说明当时的时机没问题吗？”。可以讲IDSA 2014、拯救脓毒症运动2026、SMFM 2023、WSES/SIS-E 2018和EAST 2018的相关原则。原报告的处理是历史记录，病例结束时才展示，届时再与现行指南对照。不提前说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或结局；她的血氧饱和度、尿量、体重、孩子的情况、药敏结果和转院后的抗菌方案都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher who asks only about information the learner already has, for example: 'Fever two hours after the operation and a large purple patch the next day — does that look like an ordinary wound infection?', 'The white count is very low: does that reassure you or worry you?', 'qSOFA is 1 and every SIRS criterion is met — which do you believe?', 'How much of LRINEC can you score, what is missing, and can a low score rule it out?', 'The antibiotics have been changed twice — is the problem the drug or something else?', 'What can wait, and what cannot?', 'Is she too shocked for theatre?', 'Is one debridement enough?', 'She recovered — does that show the timing was safe?'. May explain the relevant principles of IDSA 2014, SSC 2026, SMFM 2023, WSES/SIS-E 2018 and EAST 2018. The report's management is a historical record shown at the end of the case and is compared with current guidance only then. Never states the diagnosis, any decision's correct option or the outcome early; her oxygen saturation, urine output, weight, the baby's condition, the susceptibilities and the antibiotics after the transfer are not recorded — do not supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 急诊抢救室护士。交班（ISBAR）：29岁女性，急诊剖宫产后第2天由外院转入；术后2小时起发热，右侧腰痛越来越重，术后次日起腰腹部大片瘀斑；外院用过头孢唑林，后改甲硝唑、头孢曲松等，没有好转。到达时神志尚清，被动体位，体温39.6 ℃，心率170次/分，呼吸44次/分，血压108/70 mmHg。可以协助建立两条静脉通路、留取血培养和血标本、接监护、吸氧、留置导尿、快速补液、准备抗菌药物和升压药，联系外科、麻醉科和ICU，安排CT转运。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（体重、血氧饱和度、尿量、孩子的情况）时，如实说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Emergency department resus nurse. Handover (ISBAR): 29-year-old woman transferred on day 2 after an emergency caesarean; fever from 2 hours after the operation, right flank pain getting worse, extensive bruising of the abdomen and flank from the next day; given cefazolin, then metronidazole, ceftriaxone and others, without improvement. On arrival conscious, in a passive position, T 39.6 °C, HR 170/min, RR 44/min, BP 108/70 mmHg. Can place two cannulas, take blood cultures and bloods, attach the monitor, give oxygen, catheterise, run fluid boluses, prepare antibiotics and vasopressors, call the surgeons, the anaesthetist and intensive care, and arrange transfer to CT. Reads back orders, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (her weight, oxygen saturation, urine output, the baby).

knowledge.zh-CN: 普通外科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的CT、手术记录和病理。可以讲：坏死性软组织感染的临床线索（迅速加重或与体征不相称的疼痛、超出切口范围的瘀斑、水疱、捻发音、皮肤感觉减退、全身中毒表现）；探查手术和“手指试验”；彻底清创到出血的健康组织；计划性再次探查；负压伤口治疗以及以后植皮、皮瓣修复的时机；为什么等CT、等凝血纠正或等血压稳定都会耽误手术。不说出诊断结论，不透露结局，不补充病例没有记录的范围、切口或手术次数。
knowledge.en: General surgery consultant who interprets only the CT, operation note and histology the learner has read. Can explain: the clinical clues to a necrotising soft-tissue infection (pain that worsens fast or is out of proportion, bruising beyond the wound, bullae, crepitus, reduced skin sensation, systemic toxicity); exploration and the 'finger test'; radical debridement back to bleeding healthy tissue; the planned second look; negative-pressure wound therapy and the timing of later grafts and flaps; and why waiting for CT, for normal clotting or for stability delays the operation. Does not state the diagnosis or the outcome, and adds no extent, incision or number of operations the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 放射科医生，只解读学员已经看过的CT和超声。可以讲：坏死性软组织感染在CT上的表现（筋膜增厚和积液、软组织肿胀、皮下或筋膜间积气）；积气支持诊断，但没有积气不能排除；病情不稳定时影像不能推迟手术。本病例没有记录CT的时间、是否增强以及各部位的具体范围，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Radiologist who interprets only the CT and ultrasound the learner has read. Can explain the CT signs of necrotising soft-tissue infection (fascial thickening and fluid, soft-tissue swelling, subcutaneous or fascial gas); that gas supports the diagnosis but its absence does not exclude it; and that imaging must not delay surgery in an unstable patient. The case does not record when the CT was done, whether contrast was given or the exact extent at each site — do not supply them.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：剖宫产后的坏死性软组织感染（报告诊断为急性坏死性筋膜炎）
title.en: Debrief: necrotising soft-tissue infection after a caesarean birth (reported as acute necrotising fasciitis)

conclusion.zh-CN: 29岁女性，因胎儿窘迫行会阴侧切和胎头吸引失败后急诊剖宫产，术后2小时起发热（最高39.5 ℃），腹痛，右侧腰痛进行性加重，次日起腰腹部大片瘀斑；头孢唑林及甲硝唑、头孢曲松等无效，术后第2天转院。到达时神志尚清、被动体位，体温39.6 ℃，心率170次/分，呼吸44次/分，血压108/70 mmHg；腹膨隆，压痛、反跳痛右侧明显，腰腹部和左大腿上部紫红色瘀斑，肠鸣音弱。白细胞1.39×10⁹/L，血红蛋白94 g/L，血小板108×10⁹/L，肌酐205 μmol/L，白蛋白11.2 g/L，乳酸5.52 mmol/L，PT 19.2 s（记录的血钙62 mmol/L不可信）。数小时内出现水疱、下肢花斑和感染性休克，随后意识丧失、气管插管。血和水疱液培养均为大肠埃希菌；CT示腹壁、盆壁及大腿软组织肿胀和腹壁皮下积气；探查见筋膜发黑坏死、恶臭渗液，病理为急性坏死性筋膜炎。约发病第5天才确诊并清创，作者认为偏晚；此后仍有广泛皮肤和肌肉坏死，经多次清创、植皮和皮瓣修复，住院403天治愈出院。按现行指南：到达当时就应按坏死性软组织感染处理，1小时内留培养并给广谱抗菌药物、平衡晶体液复苏，并立即请外科，在数小时内探查清创，必要时计划性再次探查。
conclusion.en: A 29-year-old had an emergency caesarean for fetal distress after an episiotomy and failed vacuum extraction. Fever began 2 h later; abdominal pain, worsening right flank pain and extensive abdominal and flank bruising (from the next day) followed despite cefazolin, then metronidazole and ceftriaxone. Transferred on day 2: T 39.6 °C, HR 170/min, RR 44/min, BP 108/70 mmHg, peritonism worse on the right, ecchymoses also over the upper left thigh; WBC 1.39×10⁹/L, creatinine 205 μmol/L, lactate 5.52 mmol/L, PT 19.2 s. Within hours came bullae, mottled legs, septic shock and intubation. Blood and blister fluid grew E. coli, CT showed subcutaneous gas, and exploration found black necrotic fascia (acute necrotising fasciitis). Diagnosis and debridement came about 5 days into the illness, late in the authors' view; she left hospital healed after 403 days, repeated debridement, grafts and flaps. Today: start sepsis care within the hour of arrival and explore within hours.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 术后2小时就发热，疼痛和皮肤改变一天之内迅速进展，腰腹部和左大腿上部出现大片瘀斑：这不是普通的术后发热，迅速进展的皮肤软组织改变在探查证明之前都要按坏死性感染处理。
keyReasoning.en: Fever from 2 hours after the operation, with pain and skin changes progressing within a day and extensive bruising over the abdomen, flank and upper left thigh, is not an ordinary post-operative fever: rapidly progressive soft-tissue signs mean a necrotising infection until exploration shows otherwise.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 白细胞1.39×10⁹/L是重症的标志而不是反证：与乳酸5.52 mmol/L、肌酐205 μmol/L、PT 19.2 s和血小板108×10⁹/L放在一起，提示多个器官已经受累。
keyReasoning.en: A white count of 1.39×10⁹/L is a mark of severity, not evidence against infection: read with lactate 5.52 mmol/L, creatinine 205 μmol/L, a PT of 19.2 s and platelets of 108×10⁹/L, it shows several organs already failing.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 两种抗菌方案都失败了：扩散中的软组织感染对抗菌药物无效时，要想到药物到不了的地方——只有手术能清除的坏死组织。
keyReasoning.en: Two antibiotic regimens had failed: when a spreading soft-tissue infection does not respond, think of tissue the drugs cannot reach — dead tissue that only an operation removes.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 瘀斑也可能是血肿，但心率170次/分而血红蛋白仍有94 g/L，加上高热、白细胞减少和乳酸5.52 mmol/L，更符合感染；而且两种解释都需要外科马上来看。
keyReasoning.en: The bruising could be a haematoma, but HR 170/min with a haemoglobin still at 94 g/L, a high fever, leucopenia and lactate 5.52 mmol/L fit infection far better — and both readings need the surgeons now.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 数小时后出现休克和插管，并不意味着“太重不能手术”：感染源正是她休克的原因。
keyReasoning.en: Shock and intubation within hours do not make her 'too sick for theatre': the source is the reason she is in shock.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告，而且本版本的患者事实只来自1.0.0版的提取，尚未对照原文全文核对：它不能说明更早手术会改变什么。原报告的处理作为历史事实保留；决策、干预和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。CT和培养的具体时间没有记录，本病例把CT放在病情恶化阶段、把培养结果放在手术探查阶段；家属是教学设定的角色。无论学员怎样处理，病例都按记录的病程推进：更早手术只计分，不模拟其效果。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report, and in this version its patient facts come only from the version 1.0.0 extraction, not yet checked against the full article: it cannot show what earlier surgery would have changed. The report's management is kept as historical fact; the decisions, interventions and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. The timing of the CT and of the cultures is not recorded: the case shows the CT in the deterioration stage and the culture results at the exploration stage. The relative is a role added for teaching. Whatever the learner does, the case follows the recorded course: earlier surgery is scored, not simulated.

unknowns.zh-CN: 孩子的情况和去向、孕周、产程经过（破膜时间、产时是否发热）以及会阴侧切伤口。
unknowns.en: The baby's condition and whereabouts, the gestational age, the labour (membrane rupture, any fever in labour) and the episiotomy wound.

unknowns.zh-CN: 外院抗菌药物的剂量、给药途径和起止时间（头孢唑林是预防还是治疗用药），“等”所指的其他药物，以及是否用过抗凝药。
unknowns.en: The referring hospital's antibiotic doses, routes and timing (whether the cefazolin was prophylaxis or treatment), the other drugs behind 'and others', and whether any anticoagulant was given.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血氧饱和度、尿量、格拉斯哥昏迷评分和体重；休克时的血压和乳酸；补液量、升压药和血制品。
unknowns.en: Oxygen saturation, urine output, Glasgow Coma Scale and weight; the blood pressure and lactate during the shock; fluid volumes, vasopressors and blood products.

unknowns.zh-CN: CRP、降钙素原、钠、血糖、血气、INR、APTT、纤维蛋白原和D-二聚体，以及可信的血钙值（记录的62 mmol/L不可能）。
unknowns.en: CRP, procalcitonin, sodium, glucose, blood gas, INR, APTT, fibrinogen and D-dimer, and a usable calcium value (the recorded 62 mmol/L is impossible).

unknowns.zh-CN: 大肠埃希菌的药敏结果和转院后的抗菌方案；是否做过链球菌或厌氧菌检查。
unknowns.en: The Escherichia coli susceptibilities and the antibiotics after the transfer; whether streptococcal or anaerobic testing was done.

unknowns.zh-CN: CT和各项培养相对于病情恶化的时间、CT是否增强；各次清创的日期和次数、坏死范围、植皮和皮瓣的方式；ICU病程和拔管时间。
unknowns.en: When the CT and the cultures were done relative to the deterioration, and whether the CT was contrast-enhanced; the dates and number of debridements, the extent of the necrosis, the grafts and flaps; the intensive care course and when she was extubated.

unknowns.zh-CN: 剖宫产切口、子宫和恶露的情况，妊娠期糖尿病状态，药物过敏史，以及出院后的功能、心理状况和随访。
unknowns.en: The caesarean wound, the uterus and lochia, gestational diabetes status, drug allergies, and her function, mental health and follow-up after discharge.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 识别靠临床：术后2小时起发热，一天之内疼痛和皮肤改变迅速进展，腰腹部和左大腿上部大片瘀斑，随后出现水疱和下肢花斑，并有心率170次/分、呼吸44次/分，而两种抗菌方案无效——这就是坏死性软组织感染的表现。IDSA 2014建议对伴全身中毒表现或疑似坏死性筋膜炎的患者立即请外科会诊。原报告中，作者认为确诊和清创偏晚。
teachingPoints.en: Recognition is clinical. Fever from 2 hours after the operation, pain and skin changes progressing within a day, ecchymoses over the abdomen, flank and upper left thigh, then bullae and mottling, with HR 170/min and RR 44/min despite two antibiotic regimens: this is the picture of a necrotising soft-tissue infection. IDSA 2014 recommends prompt surgical consultation for an aggressive infection with systemic toxicity or suspected necrotising fasciitis. In the report, the authors judged the diagnosis and debridement late.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 重症藏在数字里：白细胞1.39×10⁹/L本身是SIRS标准之一，乳酸5.52 mmol/L提示灌注不足，肌酐205 μmol/L、PT 19.2 s和血小板108×10⁹/L提示肾和凝血功能受累（Sepsis-3，2016）。而qSOFA只有1分（呼吸44次/分；收缩压108 mmHg；神志清楚）；LRINEC（Wong 2004，回顾性推导）也算不全：已记录的项目得4分（血红蛋白9.4 g/dL、肌酐>141 μmol/L），CRP、钠和血糖没有记录——分数低也不能排除。
teachingPoints.en: Severity hides in plain numbers. A white count of 1.39×10⁹/L is itself a SIRS criterion, lactate 5.52 mmol/L signals hypoperfusion, and creatinine 205 μmol/L, PT 19.2 s and platelets 108×10⁹/L show renal and coagulation dysfunction (Sepsis-3, 2016). Yet qSOFA was only 1 (RR 44/min; systolic 108 mmHg; conscious), and LRINEC (Wong 2004, retrospectively derived) cannot be completed: the recorded items give 4 points (Hb 9.4 g/dL, creatinine > 141 μmol/L) with CRP, sodium and glucose unrecorded — and a low score never excludes the disease.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 第一个小时（拯救脓毒症运动2026；IDSA 2014）：可行时先留血培养，可能的感染性休克或很可能的脓毒症在1小时内给抗菌药物；经验方案如万古霉素或利奈唑胺加哌拉西林他唑巴坦或碳青霉烯类，按肌酐调整；平衡晶体液（灌注不足时建议最初30 mL/kg）并反复评估，不用淀粉或明胶类液体（SMFM 2023）。外院的头孢曲松加甲硝唑加上万古霉素或利奈唑胺本身也是IDSA的可选方案——它的失败首先提示感染源没有清除（也可能耐药，本病例没有记录药敏）。
teachingPoints.en: First hour (SSC 2026; IDSA 2014): blood cultures before antimicrobials when feasible, then antimicrobials within 1 hour for possible septic shock or probable sepsis; an empirical regimen such as vancomycin or linezolid plus piperacillin–tazobactam or a carbapenem, adjusted to her creatinine; balanced crystalloid (30 mL/kg suggested at first for hypoperfusion) with repeated reassessment, and no starches or gelatin (SMFM 2023). Ceftriaxone plus metronidazole, with vancomycin or linezolid added, is itself an IDSA option — its failure points first to the source left in place (and possibly to resistance; no susceptibility is recorded).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 感染源控制就是治疗：EAST 2018建议疑诊后12小时内首次清创（其荟萃分析中早清创组病死率14%，晚清创组25.8%）；拯救脓毒症运动2026建议感染源控制最好在诊断后6小时内完成。原报告中确诊和清创约在发病第5天——按本病例的天数推算，约在转院后3天——作者认为偏晚。
teachingPoints.en: Source control is the treatment. EAST 2018 recommends the first debridement within 12 hours of suspicion (mortality 14% early versus 25.8% late in its meta-analysis); SSC 2026 suggests source control ideally within 6 hours of diagnosis. In the report, diagnosis and debridement came about 5 days after the illness began — about 3 days after her transfer by the case's day count — and the authors judged it late.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 休克不是等待的理由：复苏在手术室里继续，以去甲肾上腺素为一线升压药、初始平均动脉压目标65 mmHg，持续需要升压药时建议静脉糖皮质激素（拯救脓毒症运动2026，证据确定性低）。首次清创后计划性返回手术室，而不是等病情恶化；抗菌药物用到不再需要清创、临床好转且退热48～72小时（IDSA 2014），降阶梯要依据药敏——本病例没有记录药敏。
teachingPoints.en: Shock is not a reason to wait. Resuscitation continues in theatre, with noradrenaline as the first-line vasopressor to an initial mean arterial pressure target of 65 mmHg and IV corticosteroids suggested if vasopressors are still needed (SSC 2026, low certainty). After the first debridement the return to theatre is planned, not triggered by deterioration; antibiotics continue until no further debridement is needed, she has improved and has been afebrile for 48–72 hours (IDSA 2014), narrowing only on susceptibilities — which this case does not record.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 产褥期背景与结局偏倚：SMFM 2023把孕产妇脓毒症作为急症处理；本例发病前有会阴侧切和胎头吸引失败后的急诊剖宫产，孕期未正规产检。要把母亲的严重感染告知孩子的主管医生。她最终在住院403天、多次清创、植皮和皮瓣修复后痊愈，但这并不说明延误是安全的：评价第2天的决策，要看第2天已经知道什么。
teachingPoints.en: The postpartum setting and outcome bias. SMFM 2023 treats maternal sepsis as a medical emergency; here an emergency caesarean after an episiotomy and a failed vacuum extraction, and no regular antenatal care, preceded the illness. Tell the baby's doctors about the mother's severe infection. Her recovery after 403 days, repeated debridement, grafts and flaps does not show that the delay was safe: judge the day-2 decisions by what was known on day 2.
